decision.summary: A multi-axis abrupt shift begins near index 490: N decreases sharply while E and U increase, forming a sustained offset lasting ~54 samples (490–543). The offset is non-symmetric across axes and shows no clear opposing return within the allowed context (up to 579); thus the interval is classified as uncertain. A candidate jump at index 557 lies outside the screened region and is not supported by adjacent observations (index 556 is null, 557 is extreme but isolated without preceding/preparatory trend or return), so it is not interpreted as a temporary offset.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply (e.g., from ~1.9 at idx 489 to ~-0.1 at idx 492), E rises (e.g., ~2.7→~3.5), U rises (e.g., ~1.2→~2.0) over indices 490–493; sustained offset persists through idx 543 with N remaining ~-0.1 to -0.5, E ~2.6–3.5, U ~1.2–2.8, without clear opposing return within allowed context [450,579]. Return not observed before end of context; status uncertain.
